description: Source code for a Zephyr-based virtualization driver implementing an ivshmem doorbell communication mechanism, including setup, event loop, and user space handling.

methods.name: wait_for_int
methods.description: Waits for an interrupt event via k_poll and updates irq status.

methods.name: ivshmem_event_loop
methods.description: Main loop handling host-guest communication via shared memory and signals.

methods.name: setup_ivshmem
methods.description: Initializes ivshmem parameters, registers handlers, and allocates signals.

methods.name: ivshmem_sample_failed
methods.description: Handles failure by printing message and halting.

methods.name: ivshmem_sample_doorbell
methods.description: Runs the ivshmem doorbell sample in kernel space.

methods.name: user_entry
methods.description: User space thread entry for ivshmem setup and event loop.

methods.name: ivshmem_sample_userspace_doorbell
methods.description: Runs the ivshmem doorbell sample in user space with memory domain setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, calls user or kernel space setup based on configuration.
